DAEMON.description: Path to the atheme-services executable binary.

NAME.description: Service name used for init.d script and log messages.

RUNDIR.description: Directory where PID file and runtime data are stored.

RUNDIR_PERMS.description: Permissions for RUNDIR directory (passed to chmod).
